text:
Eva Gupta: Quick sync — proposal to add a lightweight observability curve for the onboard bench/probe pipeline. Goal: surface fidelity regressions earlier with minimal cost. Thoughts?
Nate: +1. Can you sketch signals? e.g., per-model golden-input drift, token-level perplexity delta, latency vs perf curve.
Eva Gupta: Exactly. My rough list: golden-input pass rate, output SHA similarity, eval-set metric delta, 95/99p latency, sample-size bias. Also a signal for quantization mismatches.
Talia: How do we avoid blowing cost? Full eval on every model is expensive.
Eva Gupta: Plan is stratified sampling: smoke (small), microbench (micro-batch), and full bench on canary. Default smoke on every ingest, microbench on new families, full only for flagged deltas or scheduled runs.
Chris: Interface question: where does sampling live? Intake service or bench runner? We should avoid coupling the intake to heavy logic.
Nate: I'd push sampling config into the onboarding policy (db row) and intake emits a lightweight "probe-request" event. Bench service subscribes and pulls workload.
Talia: That sounds good. Also we need deterministic golden inputs stored as artifacts + feature fingerprint to guard against input drift.
Kevin: For compatibility checks we must include model signature (tokens, kv-format, tensor-layout). If the runtime rejects binary, we fail fast.
Maria: Can we reuse existing bench infra telemetry? e.g., bench-prober already emits histograms — add labels for sample_bucket and source=onboard.
Eva Gupta: Yes reuse. New metrics: onboard_fidelity{model,stage,bucket}, onboard_latency_ms{p50,p95,p99}, onboard_regression_flag. Also add a lightweight trace id linking intake->bench->runtime.
Edna_SRE_Bot: infra note — streaming these metrics at high cardinality will spike Prometheus. Suggest pushgateway + aggregator + sampling, or route to metrics pipeline with downsampling.
Chris: For API, propose intake returns a probe_id and a status endpoint: /onboard/{id}/probe-status
Nate: Also add webhooks for customers on Dedicated/Private to receive probe results if they opt-in.
Talia: Rollout plan: feature-flag smoke by default for new models; opt-in full bench. After 2 weeks, enable auto-flagging regressions for staging canaries.
Eva Gupta: Action items:
- Nate: schema for probe_request event + probe_id (due EOD)
- Chris: /onboard probe-status endpoint contract (this week)
- Kevin: list of signature checks and failure modes (tomorrow)
- Maria: add metric labels and low-cardinality plan with SRE (sync Thurs)
- Talia: doc for sampling buckets and thresholds (draft by Fri)
Nate: I'll post a short RFC with event schema + state machine. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Kevin: Quick ask — include a small example payload in RFC, e.g.,
```
{ "probe_id": "p-12345", "model": "ggml-13b-fp16", "sample_bucket": "smoke", "trace_id": "t-abc" }
```
Eva Gupta: Perfect. Closing thread — will follow up with RFC link.
